lines: In the Philippine mountains, travelers fear a tall creature of the forest.
It has a horse's head, and knees that rise above its shoulders.
Legend says the tikbalang loves to make travelers lose their way.
You walk for hours, yet every path leads back to the same tree.
Elders say to wear your shirt inside out, and the spell breaks.
And always ask permission as you pass: tabi tabi po.
Forget, and you may hear a low whinny in the dark behind you.
A lone white horse on the trail may not be a horse at all.
title: The Horse-Headed Creature That Makes You Lose Your Way #shorts
description:
In Filipino folklore the tall tikbalang leads travelers in circles through the mountain forest. How do you break its spell?
